title: Localized ring-sheaf mates evaluated along graphs
statement:
Let $B$ be a scheme, let $u:V\to B$ be an object of its small pro-étale site with the universe convention of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and use the inverse image $u^{-1}$ of [def-sfb-finite-upper-star] on abelian sheaves (and its induced ring-object functor). Let $R$ and $S$ be sheaves of commutative rings on $B_{\mathrm{proét}}$ and $V_{\mathrm{proét}}$, respectively, and let $\beta:u^{-1}R\xrightarrow{\sim}S$ be a ring-sheaf isomorphism. Under the restriction identification of clause (1) of [lem-sfb-proetale-object-inverse-image-restriction], write $\bar\beta:R|_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S$; restriction and its ring operations are those of [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let $e_u:R\to u_*u^{-1}R$ be the unit of the sheafified-left-Kan-extension adjunction of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and put $\eta^\beta=u_*\beta\circ e_u$.

For every $T\to B$ in $B_{\mathrm{proét}}$ and $a\in R(T)$, with $T\times_BV$ viewed over $V$ by the second projection, one has
$$e_{u,T}(a)=R(\operatorname{pr}_T)(a),\qquad \eta^\beta_T(a)=\bar\beta_{T\times_BV}\bigl(R(\operatorname{pr}_T)(a)\bigr),$$
where the first equality uses the stated restriction identification. For every $U\to V$ in $V_{\mathrm{proét}}$ and every $B$-map $b:U\to T$, let $\gamma_b=(b,U\to V):U\to T\times_BV$. Then
$$S(\gamma_b)\eta^\beta_T(a)=\bar\beta_U(R(b)(a)).$$
In particular, with $\delta:V\to V\times_BV$ the diagonal, the map $S(\delta)\eta^\beta_V$ is the ring isomorphism $\bar\beta_{V/V}:R(V)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(V,S)$. For a global section $r\in\Gamma(B,R)$, pullback of the map $\underline{\mathbf Z}\to R$ sending $1$ to $r$, followed by $\beta$, is the global section $\bar\beta_{V/V}(R(u)(r))$; the monoidal-unit comparison is the canonical one for inverse image.
